theorem: Fourier diagonalization turns exact cyclic garbling into componentwise multiplication. Invertibility gives the exact zero-deficiency criterion. Character duality bounds every Fourier residual by its l1 norm and yields the displayed computable lower bound.
zero_deficiency_criterion: if every Fourier coefficient of p is nonzero, delta(C_p,C_q)=0 iff IDFT(qhat/phat) is a probability vector
